sources.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Omni-Modal Interaction AI - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: The paper introduces a 9-billion parameter model integrating a streaming visual encoder, audio encoder, and LLM backbone with token-level hidden state fusion. MiniCPM-o 4.5 is defined as an omni-modal foundation model that enables real-time, full-duplex interactions across vision, audio, text, and speech with proactive behavior mechanisms. It employs the novel Omni-Flow streaming architecture ...

sources.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: 9B Vision, Audio, and Speech Model - LearnOpenCV
sources.snippet: MiniCPM-o 4.5 is a 9B open-source model that can see, hear, and speak simultaneously. We test its full-duplex Omni-Flow streaming on real-world videos.
